blocks.text: Jandar (organisms) khoorak ke molecules se tawanai (energy) apne cells mein catabolic amal se hasil karte hain, jinhen majmui taur par cellular respiration kehte hain (glycolysis, Krebs cycle aur electron transport chain); yeh oxygen istemal karte aur carbon dioxide banate hain. External respiration jism ke nizam (body-system) ki satah par mahol se oxygen lena aur us mein carbon dioxide nikalna hai; is mein saans lena (breathing) aur capillaries mein oxygen aur carbon dioxide ka tabadla shamil hai. Yeh amal karne wale aza (organs) nizam-e-tanaffus (respiratory system) banate hain. Is ke bare aza phephre (lungs) hain, jo gaison ke tabadle ke liye munasib tanaffusi satah (respiratory surface) dete hain.

blocks.title: Yaad-dehani
blocks.text: Hamare cells khoon se oxygen lete hain, aur khoon use hamare phephron ki hawa se leta hai. Oxygen phephron ki geeli jhilliyon ke paar diffuse hoti hai, jo saans lene ke amal mein hawa se bharti hain.
Tanaffusi satah (respiratory surface) ki khusoosiyat

Tanaffusi satah woh raqba hai jahan mahol aur khoon ke darmiyan asal gas ka tabadla diffusion se hota hai. Insanon aur hawa mein saans lene wale doosre reerh-daron (vertebrates) mein hawa ki oxygen khoon mein diffuse hoti hai aur carbon dioxide khoon se hawa mein. Saat khusoosiyat tanaffusi sathon ko gaison ka moassar tabadla karne ke qabil banati hain.

items: Yeh nam (moist) aur guzarne dene wali (permeable) hai, taake gaisein is se guzar saken.
Yeh patli hai, taake gaisein kam se kam fasla tay karein.
Is ko khoon ki faraahmi hai, taake gaisein khoon ke andar aur bahar diffuse ho saken.
Is ko banawati sahara hai, taake yeh khuli rahe aur beth na jaye.
Yeh andar ki taraf waqe hai, taake is ki nam satah fiza mein pani na khoye.
Hawa is par chalti (ventilate) hai, yani is ki taraf aur is se door harkat karti hai.
Hawa is tak shakhdar nali-numa raste se guzar kar pohnchti hai, taake pohnchne se pehle pani ke bukharat se sair (saturated) ho jaye.

blocks.alt: Thaili (sac) jaisi tanaffusi satah jo oopar se khuli hai; do teer dikhate hain ke hawa us ki gardan se andar aur bahar jati hai. Is ki deewar ek cell moti hai aur andar nam (moist) tah hai, aur neeche khoon ki naliyon ki patti lipti hai. Khamdar teer dikhate hain ke carbon dioxide khoon se thaili mein aur oxygen thaili se khoon mein jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.1: Tanaffusi satah ki kuch khusoosiyat (textbook ki Figure 10.1 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Air moves in and out; Thin (one cell); Moist (with water & mucus); Blood supply; O2; CO2.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure ke chaar labels list ki khusoosiyat se milte hain: 'Air moves in and out' (hawa aati jati hai, ventilation), 'Thin (one cell)' (patli deewar, kam fasla), 'Moist' (nami mein gaisein ghul kar guzarti hain) aur 'Blood supply' (khoon O2 le jata aur CO2 lata hai).
Insani nizam-e-tanaffus ke ajza

Nizam-e-tanaffus ke aza raston ka ek musalsal nizam banate hain, tanaffusi rasta (respiratory tract), jis se hawa jism ke andar aur bahar behti hai. Is ki do bari taqseemein hain, oopri (upper) respiratory tract aur nichla (lower) respiratory tract.
Upper respiratory tract

Oopri rasta nasal cavity, pharynx aur larynx par mushtamil hai. Yeh aza hawa ko jism ke andar aur bahar le jate hain aur aane wali hawa ko saaf, nam aur garam bhi karte hain; in mein gas ka koi tabadla nahin hota.

items: Nasal cavity (naak ka khala): naak ke bairooni surakh, nathne (nostrils), naak ke peeche ek bare hawa-bhare khale tak le jate hain, jo nasal septum (naak ki haddi ka hissa) se batta hai. Jab saans ki hawa is se guzarti hai to is ki satah ke bohat qareeb khoon ki naliyan use garam aur nam karti hain, aur naak ke baal aur mucous jhilliyon ka mucus bare ajnabi zarrat ko gehrai mein jane se pehle phansa lete hain. Nasal cavity mein soonghne (smell) ke liye darkar chemoreceptors bhi hain, jo zaiqe ke ehsaas mein hissa dalte hain.

Pharynx: nali-numa banawat jo nasal aur oral cavities ko larynx aur oesophagus se jorti hai. Is se hawa aur khoorak dono guzarti hain, is liye yeh tanaffusi aur hazmi dono nizamon ka hissa hai: hawa nasal cavity se pharynx ke raste larynx tak jati hai (aur wapas), aur khoorak munh se pharynx ke raste oesophagus tak.

Larynx: pharynx aur trachea ko jorta hai aur pathon (muscles) aur cartilages ka bana hai. Ise awaz ka dabba (voice box) bhi kehte hain kyunke is mein smooth muscle ki do pattiyan, vocal cords, hain jo hawa guzarne par larazti hain aur yun awaz paida karti hain. Larynx ke pathe vocal cords ko alag karte hain taake saans li ja sake, aur doosre pathe unhen mila kar awazein paida karte aur un ki pitch aur volume qaboo karte hain.

blocks.alt: Sar aur seene ka pehlu se manzar. Sar aur gardan mein nasal cavity, pharynx aur larynx ko upper respiratory tract ki bracket mein rakha gaya hai. Neeche cartilage ke halqon wali trachea do bronchi mein batti hai jo dono phephron ke andar shakhein banati hain; yeh lower respiratory tract hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.2: Tanaffusi rasta (respiratory tract) (textbook ki Figure 10.2 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Upper Respiratory Tract (Nasal cavity, Pharynx, Larynx); Lower Respiratory Tract (Trachea, Bronchus, Lung).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Textbook ki caption aur headings mein 'Respiratory track' chhapa hai; sahi lafz 'tract' (rasta) hai, isi liye yahan 'tract' likha gaya hai.

Epiglottis cartilage ka ek parda (flap) hai jo larynx ke munh, glottis, ke samne aur oopar phaila hai. Jab hawa larynx mein aati hai to epiglottis oopar khara reh kar use rasta deta hai. Jab hum kuch nigalte hain to zaban ki peeche ki harkat larynx ko uthati hai, jis se epiglottis neeche dab kar glottis band kar deta hai aur nigla hua mawad larynx mein jane se rukta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen, bahar se manzar: larynx, cartilage ki dhaal jis ke oopar epiglottis ka sira hai, trachea ke oopar hai; trachea C shakal ke cartilage halqon ki tube hai. Daen, oopar se manzar: aage epiglottis, trachea ke gehre surakh ke gird V bana ti halki vocal cords, aur un ke gird cartilage ka halqa.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.3: Larynx aur trachea (textbook ki Figure 10.3 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Larynx, Trachea, External view; Epiglottis, Vocal cords, Trachea, Cartilage, View from top.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar se dekhne par vocal cords V ki shakal mein hain; un ke beech ki khuli jagah (glottis) se hawa trachea mein jati hai. Nigalte waqt epiglottis is surakh ko dhak leta hai.

blocks.title: Khansi ka reflex
blocks.text: Agar nigla hua mawad larynx mein jane lage to woh larynx ko khush-khush kar ke ek zordar khansi ka reflex ubharta hai, jo aam taur par mawad ko larynx se bahar gale mein nikal deta hai.
Lower respiratory tract

Trachea aur nichle raste ke doosre guzargahein hawa ko oopri raste aur phephron ke darmiyan le jate hain. Yeh baar baar shakhein nikal kar darakht jaisi shakal banate hain; insani tanaffusi raste mein hawa le jane wale raston ki lambai hairat-angez 2,414 kilometre hai. Magar hawa aur khoon ke darmiyan gas ka tabadla sirf phephron mein hota hai.

blocks.alt: Trachea dono phephron ke beech neeche aa kar do bronchi mein batti hai, jo daen aur baen phephre ke andar baar baar shakhein banati hain, jaise ulta darakht.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.4: Lower respiratory tract ki darakht jaisi shakhein (textbook ki Figure 10.4 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Trachea, Right lung, Left lung.

items: Trachea (hawa ki nali, windpipe): larynx ko phephron se jorti hai aur raste ki sab se chauri guzargah hai, qareeb 1 inch chauri aur 4 se 6 inch lambi. Is ki deewarein smooth muscle aur C ki shakal ke cartilage ke halqon ki bani hain, jo rasta khula rakhne ke liye mazbooti aur sahara dete hain. Is par mucus aur cilia ki tah hai; cilia mucus mein phanse ajnabi zarrat ko pharynx ki taraf dhakelte hain. Neeche trachea do bronchi mein batti hai.

Bronchi, bronchioles aur alveoli: do primary bronchi (wahid bronchus) phephron mein dakhil ho kar chhote secondary bronchi mein batte hain, baen phephre mein do aur daen mein teen. Secondary bronchi mein C ki shakal ke cartilages ki jagah cartilage ki plates hoti hain. Yeh aur chhote tertiary bronchi mein batte hain, jo aage bohat chhote bronchioles mein batte hain, jin mein cartilage ki plates nahin hotin. Bronchioles kai baar taqseem ho kar terminal bronchioles banate hain, jo alveolar ducts par khatm hote hain jo nanhe hawa ke thailon, alveoli (wahid alveolus), ke guchhon mein khatm hoti hain.

Phephre (lungs): raste ke sab se bare aza. Har phephra do jhilliyon se dhaka hai: visceral pleura phephre par aur parietal pleura seene ke khale (thoracic cavity) ki andarooni deewar par. In ke darmiyan ki chhoti jagah, pleural cavity, mayah (fluid) se bhari hai jo phephron ko saans ke dauran azadi se phailne aur sukarne deta hai. Har phephra lobes mein batta hai: daen phephra bara hai aur teen lobes rakhta hai, baen chhota aur do lobes wala, jo seene ke markaz se zara baen dil ke liye jagah chhorta hai.

blocks.alt: Trachea primary bronchi mein batti hai, jo phephron ke andar secondary aur tertiary bronchi banati hain. Daen phephre (tasveer mein baen taraf) ke superior, middle aur inferior lobes hain; chhota baen phephra superior aur inferior lobes rakhta hai aur us ke neeche andar ke kinare par cardiac notch hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.5: Daen aur baen phephre (textbook ki Figure 10.5 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Trachea, Primary bronchus, Secondary bronchus, Tertiary bronchus, Superior lobe, Middle lobe, Inferior lobe, Cardiac notch, Right lung, Left lung.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen phephra chhota hai aur us mein cardiac notch (dil ke liye khali jagah) hai, is liye us ke sirf do lobes hain. Har lobe ko ek secondary bronchus milti hai: daen taraf teen, baen taraf do.
Alveoli

Har alveolar duct 20 se 30 alveoli ke guchhe mein khulti hai. Yeh guchhe phephre ka bara hissa banate hain aur khoon ki capillaries se ghire hain. Alveolus sirf 0.1 micrometre moti nam epithelial tissue ka bana hai, is liye alveoli wohi tanaffusi satah dete hain jahan hawa aur khoon ke darmiyan gas ka tabadla hota hai. Alveoli phephron ki kaam karne wali ikaiyan (functional units) hain; dono phephron mein 700 million tak ho sakte hain, jo bohat bara kul satahi raqba dete hain. Jab hum saans andar lete hain to alveoli hawa se bharte aur phephre phailte hain; alveolar hawa ki oxygen un ke gird nanhi capillaries ke jaal mein diffusion se jazb hoti hai, aur un capillaries ka khoon carbon dioxide, diffusion hi se, alveolar hawa mein chhorta hai. Jab hum saans bahar nikalte hain to hawa alveoli se fiza mein jati hai aur carbon dioxide saath le jati hai.

blocks.title: Surfactant aur phephron ko khoon ki faraahmi
blocks.text: Alveoli ke kuch epithelial cells surfactant naam ka mayah banate hain, jo alveoli ke andar ki tah banata hai aur hawa nikalne par unhen bethne aur aapas mein chipakne se rokta hai; sehatmand phephron mein yeh musalsal banta aur dobara jazb hota hai. Pulmonary arteries oxygen se khali khoon phephron tak lati hain, jahan woh oxygen jazb karta hai, aur pulmonary veins oxygen wala khoon wapas dil tak le jati hain taake poore jism mein pump ho. Phephre apne cells ki cellular respiration ke liye dil se oxygen wala khoon bhi lete hain.

blocks.alt: Terminal bronchiole alveolar duct mein jati hai jo gol alveoli ke do guchhon (sacs) mein khulti hai. Ek guchhe ki bahari satah par capillaries ka jaal hai jo neele se surkh hota jata hai. Neeli pulmonary artery aur surkh pulmonary vein hawa ke raste ke saath chalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.6: Alveoli ke guchhe (textbook ki Figure 10.6 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Cluster/Sac of alveoli, Capillaries, Alveolar duct, Terminal bronchiole, Pulmonary artery, Pulmonary vein, Alveolus.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pulmonary artery mein khoon deoxygenated (neela) hai aur pulmonary vein mein oxygenated (surkh). Capillaries alveoli ke andar nahin, bahar lipti hain; gas patli deewar ke aar-paar diffuse hoti hai.
Saans lene ya ventilation ka mechanism

Hawa ki jism ke andar aur bahar harkat saans lena (breathing) ya ventilation hai. Hamare phephre hawa kheenchte ya dhakelte nahin; yeh phephron mein manfi aur musbat dabao bana kar hota hai, pathon ke do giroh ke zariye: diaphragm, ek gumbad jaisa bara skeletal muscle jo seene ke khale ko pait se alag karta hai, aur har do pasliyon (ribs) ke darmiyan ke intercostal muscles.

items: Inspiration (inhalation), hawa andar lena: diaphragm sukarta hai, jo use neeche karta aur zyada chapti shakal deta hai, aur isi waqt intercostal muscles sukar kar pasliyan uthate aur pasliyon ka pinjra (rib cage) phailate hain. Yeh sukar seene (thorax) mein jagah barhate hain, to visceral aur parietal pleural jhilliyon ke chipke hone ki wajah se phephre phailte hain. Phailne se phephron ke andar hawa ka dabao fizai dabao se kam ho jata hai, aur hawa andar aati hai.

Expiration (exhalation), hawa bahar nikalna: inspiration ke dauran thorax aur phephron ka phailna unhen lachakdar tanao (elastic tension) mein rakhta hai, jo intercostal muscles aur diaphragm ke dheele hone par khatm hota hai. Diaphragm apni gumbad shakal wapas leta hai aur intercostal muscles dheele hone par pasliyan neeche aati aur pinjra andar ki taraf jata hai. Yeh harkatein thorax mein jagah kam karti aur phephron ko wapas sukarne (recoil) deti hain, to phephron ke andar dabao fizai dabao se zyada ho jata hai aur hawa bahar nikalti hai.

blocks.alt: Seene ke do saamne ke manzar. Inspiration (inhalation): hawa trachea se andar aati hai; surkh teer pasliyon ke pinjre ko bahar aur chapte diaphragm ko neeche jata dikhate hain, aur phephre bare hain. Expiration (exhalation): hawa bahar jati hai; teer pinjre ko andar aur gumbad bane diaphragm ko oopar jata dikhate hain, aur phephre chhote hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.7: Saans lene ka mechanism (textbook ki Figure 10.7 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Air moves in; Intercostal muscles contract and rib cage expands; Lung; Diaphragm; Diaphragm contracts (moves down); Inspiration (Inhalation); Air moves out; Intercostal muscles relax and rib cage becomes smaller; Diaphragm relaxes (moves up); Expiration (Exhalation).

blocks.title: Oonchai aur parinde
blocks.text: Oonche maqamat par fizai dabao kam hai, is liye phephron ka dabao fizai se kam karne ke liye thorax mein zyada izafa chahiye, isi liye wahan saans lena mushkil hai; jism oxygen lene ko behtar banane ke liye dhalta hai, isi liye khilari aksar muqable se pehle oonchai par training karte hain. Parindon mein phephre aur hawa ki thailiyan (air sacs) hain, aur hawa ek simt mein behti hai, bahar se pichli air sacs tak, phir phephron, agli air sacs aur bahar, khoon ke bahao ke ulat, to gas ka tabadla kahin zyada moassar hota hai aur parinde kam oxygen wali oonchai par bhi kafi oxygen hasil karte hain.

blocks.alt: Ek parinde ka pehlu se manzar do dafa. Har ek mein trachea seene ke andar phephron tak jati hai; phephron ke aage anterior air sacs aur peeche posterior air sacs hain. Inhalation mein air sacs bhare (bare) hain aur exhalation mein sukre (chhote).
blocks.caption: Parinde ke air sacs aur phephre (textbook ke 'High altitudes and birds' box ki drawing ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Anterior air sacs, Posterior air sacs, Lungs, Inhalation, Exhalation.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Parinde mein hawa ek hi rukh mein chalti hai: bahar se posterior air sacs, phir phephre, phir anterior air sacs aur bahar. Inhalation mein dono air sacs bharte hain, exhalation mein khali hote hain; phephron mein hawa dono waqt aage barhti rehti hai, is liye gas ka tabadla zyada hota hai.
Saans ka qaboo

Har saans medulla oblongata, dimagh ke tane (brain stem) ke ek hisse, ke tanaffusi markaz (respiratory centre) ke neurons shuru karte hain. Yeh neurons diaphragm aur intercostal muscles ko impulses bhejte hain, unhen sukarne par ubharte hain aur inspiration karate hain. Jab yeh neurons impulses banana band karte hain to diaphragm aur intercostal muscles dheele hote hain aur expiration hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Samjhayein ke jo shakhs diaphragm nahin hila sakta woh phir bhi saans kyun le sakta hai, magar kam gehri, aur pleural cavity mein surakh ho jaye to phephra kyun nahin phailta.
blocks.explanation: Intercostal muscles phir bhi pasliyan utha kar thorax bara kar sakte hain, jo phephron ka dabao itna gira deta hai ke kuch hawa andar aaye, magar diaphragm ke chapte hue baghair hajm mein izafa chhota hai, is liye har saans kam gehri hai. Phephre sirf is liye phailte hain ke visceral aur parietal pleurae pleural cavity ke mayah se chipki hain; agar us khale mein hawa aa jaye to chipkan khatm ho jati hai aur phephra seene ki deewar ke saath nahin chalta.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: External respiration jism ki satah par O2 lena aur CO2 nikalna hai; tanaffusi satah nam, permeable, patli, khoon wali, sahare wali, andarooni, ventilated aur shakhdar naliyon se pohnchi hui honi chahiye.

Oopri rasta (nasal cavity, pharynx, vocal cords aur epiglottis wala larynx) hawa tayyar karta hai; nichla rasta (C ki shakal ke cartilage wali trachea, bronchi, bronchioles, alveolar ducts) use alveoli tak le jata hai, jo teen aur do lobes wale, pleurae mein lipte phephron ke andar tabadle ki wahid jagah hain.
Alveoli: 20-30 ke guchhe, 0.1 micrometre deewarein, 700 million tak, gird capillaries, andar surfactant.

Saans: diaphragm aur intercostal muscles sukar kar thorax bara karte hain, dabao girta aur hawa aati hai; dheele hote hain, phephre sukarte hain, dabao barhta aur hawa nikalti hai. Medulla oblongata ka tanaffusi markaz ise chalata hai.
